display_information.name: Kithena
display_information.description: Ask Kithena about your people: who is in a team, who reports to whom, what waits for your approval.
display_information.long_description: Kithena answers questions about the people in your company, as you: it only ever shows what you could see in Kithena yourself. Type /kithena followed by a question, mention @Kithena in a channel, or send it a direct message. Examples: /kithena who reports to Michael? · /kithena how many people are in Scranton, by department? · /kithena what is waiting for my approval?
